artifacts.summary: Eight linear phases (13 h): forward-slack regime lemmas, wired refutation plus plateau inhabitant, spaced pigeonhole and room bound, given-block iterated duplication, one-step deletion, overshoot loop, exact-shift theorem with the slack-restricted cell inclusion, record and full gate; seven statements pinned and snapshotted.

memory_candidates.content: lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --check compares the whitespace-normalized header text (from the theorem keyword to :=) of each pinned Challenge declaration against the working tree's same-named declaration. A library declaration that takes {Q : Type} or {pend : Q -> Bool} from a section `variable` line therefore reads as drift against a Challenge block that writes those binders explicitly (the Challenge module must write them, since it is elaborated standalone). Lean plans in this repo should instruct the implementer to restate the implicit binders verbatim in the landed declaration (shadowing the section variables is harmless), and should never pin an already-landed theorem whose body is being refactored: a same-named declaration in a module importing the target does not elaborate; use a before/after header diff for that case instead.
